d:
Goutam Ghose’s Paar (1984) follows Naurangia, a Dalit labourer, and his pregnant wife, Rama, who flee their Bihar village after a massacre triggered by resistance against upper-caste landlords. Forced into poverty and displacement, the couple struggle to survive in an unfamiliar city. Their desperate search for work leads to a gruelling journey across a river, exposing the cruelty of caste oppression and the indignities imposed on society’s most marginalised.
